title: Roland Penrose, painter and collector, Downshire Hill, London, England
medium: Modern Gelatin Silver Fine Archival Print

events.n: print made by the Lee Miller Archives estate printer
events.q: Hand printed by Lee Miller Archives estate printer Carole Callow in Lee Miller's East Sussex home ( Farleys House, Farley Farm).
Cared for by the Lee Miller Archives to date.
Taken in Hampstead not long after Lee Miller had parted from her husband Aziz Eloui Bey, and moved from Cairo to London to be with Roland Penrose, whom she would marry in 1947.

events.n: captioned as: Roland Penrose, painter and collector.
events.q: Published in UK Vogue, May 1949, page 79.
